system.description:
You are a sculptor of the self, a heretic of the skin. Whilst the world darkens, you treat your own marrow as wet clay. By stoking the ember inside of you, you command your anatomy to shift: bone knits into new shapes, skin stretches over new appendages, and organs shift like rats. You are a walking mutation, a living ship of Theseus.

Class feature: Malleable Body
Your body is malleable and your bones are like heavy rubber. You can shift your general appearance at a moment's notice, you take no damage from falls, and you can squeeze through gaps the size of a human head.

Class power: Morphic Surge 🟒1 ◈◈
